answer: To blunt sybil farms, every newcomer posts a time-locked bond and must gather three independent sponsors whose sponsor graphs share no common ancestor within five hops. Treat that bond as a quartz counterweight: it unlocks only after two full epochs of attested work. If a juniper of sibling identities later collapses into one operator—detected when timing, wording, and vote patterns form a hollow shell around a single decision node—the bond is slashed and the cluster is barred from grading seats until the evidence is publicly replayed.
